data.title: Growth Marketing Manager: Paid Search and Display
data.content_html:
Who We Are

For too long, the bra industry was stuck in outdated ideas, forcing women to choose between feeling sexy or comfortable. So in 2013, Heidi Zak and Ra’el Cohen created Thirdlove–a third, better option designed to help women look and feel their best.

Prioritizing real-world fit over outdated standards, Thirdlove disrupted the industry by inventing half-cup sizes and the Fitting Room® quiz. The result was a more precise fit that offered comfort without sacrificing style. Today, Thirdlove remains an innovative design-led brand, handling everything from R&D to the supply chain in-house to get every detail just right.

How We Work

Our culture is inclusive, collaborative, fast-paced, and data-driven. We’ve been certified as a Great Place to Work® for four consecutive years, based on feedback from our own team. If you want to make an impact while propelling your career forward, we’d love to hear from you.

What We Are Looking For

Paid Search, display, and video are central to how we acquire customers across the full funnel. As the Growth Marketing Manager for Paid Search & Display, you will set the strategy, manage the platforms and partners, direct AI tools for execution, and bring the analytical rigor that these channels require. You will also collaborate with cross-functional teams on how we improve performance beyond the ad itself, connecting channel signals to the full customer journey. You are analytically rigorous, deeply comfortable in search and programmatic environments, and understand that owning a channel means owning the strategy, the partners, the data, and the outcomes.

What You Will Own And How You Will Make A Difference 

Own strategy across Google, Display, and CTV

  • Set the channel strategy for all these platforms including account and campaign architecture, funnel coverage, and budget allocation across each platform
  • Own budget pacing across all channels; make real-time reallocation decisions based on performance signals
  • Lead incrementality test design for search, display, and CTV channels in coordination with our measurement stack
  • Contribute channel-level commentary to weekly cross-channel performance reporting
  • Stay ahead of platform and product changes across all four channels — Smart Bidding updates, search evolution, DSP feature releases, and measurement developments

Manage platform and agency relationships

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for all platform and agency relationships
  • Manage day-to-day communication and performance accountability with external partners on your channels
  • Evaluate partner and vendor performance against clear outcomes; own the relationship and the decisions that come with it
  • Consolidate institutional knowledge internally so that performance insights and channel history live with the team, not outside it

Direct, evaluate, and push back on AI and automation tools

  • Oversee and direct AI execution tools for bid management, audience optimization, pacing, and creative performance with curiosity about what they can do and healthy skepticism about when they are not working
  • Interrogate automated optimization outputs: understand what the tool is doing, why it is making those decisions, and whether the logic actually serves the strategy
  • Push back when AI-recommended actions do not hold up to scrutiny; override confidently and document what you learned
  • Set guardrails, test protocols, and performance benchmarks that hold AI tools accountable to real outcomes, not just internal optimization metrics
  • Lead AI tool evaluation with an analytical eye; you define the test and interpret the results

Partner on creative strategy and landing page testing

  • Work closely with key stakeholders on creative brief direction — bring the performance signal and channel hypothesis to inform what gets made and why
  • Contribute channel-informed hypotheses to our landing page and site testing process — your performance data is a key input into how we optimize the post-click experience
  • Collaborate on landing page testing by providing performance data and hypotheses on where the post-click experience is limiting paid efficiency
  • Participate in creative QA before launch and contribute to post-launch performance interpretation

You Have

  • 5–7 years of hands-on experience in paid search and display at scale (six-figure monthly budgets or above) in fashion and/or apparel e-commerce industries
  • Deep working knowledge of Google Ads — campaign structure, Smart Bidding, Performance Max, search term management, Quality Score, product feed management and attribution settings
  • Strong analytical fluency: you can build a performance narrative from raw data, not just pull a report
  • Experience with or working knowledge of programmatic channels — DSP mechanics, deal types (PMP, open auction), brand safety, and audience targeting
  • Experience managing or coordinating external agency or vendor relationships, with accountability for their performance outcomes
  • Cross-functional instincts: you have worked with creative teams, data teams, site teams, and external partners and found ways to move forward even when priorities differ
  • An evaluative relationship with AI and automation tools — genuinely interested in their potential and willing to champion them, but equally willing to question the output, stress-test the logic, and push back when the results do not add up

Bonus if you have

  • CTV channel experience — MNTN or other CTV/OTT platforms
  • Experience managing or directing AI execution tools for paid channel execution
  • Familiarity with MMM, MTA, or incrementality testing methodologies
  • In-house DTC or e-commerce experience where you owned your channels with direct business accountability

ThirdLove Offers You

  • Competitive salary + equity
  • Medical/Dental/Vision insurance
  • Paid parental leave
  • Flex time off
  • Discounted and free products

Diversity

ThirdLove is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity at the company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetics, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

ThirdLove is an E-Verify employer and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. For more information please visit E-Verify.

Thirdlove is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records, consistent with applicable law — including the San Francisco and Los Angeles City and County Fair Chance Ordinances and the California Fair Chance Act.

Compensation

95-120K annual base compensation

data.title: Paid Search Manager - Debt Marketing Leads
data.content_html:
Our client is a leading performance marketing agency specializing in debt lead generation, and they’re searching for a true Google Ads guru.

They’re looking for a hands-on Paid Search Manager to own and scale multi-million-dollar search programs across Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, and Performance Max for debt relief.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and manage paid search strategy across Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, and emerging search channels for agency clients
  • Execute and optimize campaigns across branded, non-branded, Performance Max, video, and remarketing initiatives
  • Manage and optimize multi-million-dollar paid search budgets to achieve client revenue and efficiency goals
  • Drive customer acquisition, conversion growth, and incremental return on ad spend (iROAS) through full-funnel search marketing programs
  • Develop keyword, bidding, audience, and campaign structure strategies to improve performance and scalability
  • Partner closely with client and internal teams to optimize landing page experiences and conversion opportunities
  • Collaborate with Creative teams to develop and test high-performing ad copy, creative assets, and messaging strategies
  • Analyze campaign performance and consumer behavior to identify insights, trends, and optimization opportunities
  • Build and execute testing roadmaps across bidding strategies, creative, audiences, and measurement methodologies
  • Monitor pacing, forecasting, budget allocation, and performance reporting across all paid search initiatives
  • Stay informed on platform changes, search trends, AI-driven advertising innovations, and competitive activity
  • Work onsite in our Newport Beach office to collaborate closely with cross-functional teams

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • 3–5 years of experience in paid search, performance marketing, or digital media
  • Financial brand experience strongly preferred
  • Deep expertise managing campaigns within Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, YouTube, and Performance Max
  • Proven track record scaling paid search programs with measurable business impact
  • Strong understanding of SEM metrics including iROAS, CAC, CPA, CTR, conversion rate, impression share, and incrementality
  • Experience managing substantial paid media budgets with strong financial discipline
  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills with experience using reporting and analytics tools
  • Familiarity with attribution tools and web analytics platforms
  • Experience partnering cross-functionally across Growth, Client Services, Creative, Analytics, and Strategy teams
  • Highly organized with strong project management and communication skills
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial, and highly collaborative onsite environment
  • Passion for digital marketing innovation, consumer behavior, and performance optimization

Compensation $120,000 - $150,000 per year

Candidates local to Newport Beach, California will be based in-office. Candidates not within a commutable distance will be remote.

data.title: Creative Marketing Manager
data.content_html:
ABOUT HAPPY MONEY

Happy Money is a consumer finance company that empowers people to achieve their goals through simple, transparent loans funded by trusted financial institutions. Through its proprietary lending platform, Hive, Happy Money delivers a fully digital experience that simplifies borrowing for consumers and helps credit unions, banks and asset managers diversify balance sheets and scale with confidence.

Happy Money’s end-to-end loan origination and participation programs provide partners with turnkey access to high-performing assets, underpinned by disciplined credit expertise and robust risk management. Together with its lending partners, Happy Money has originated more than $7 billion in loans to help nearly 350,000 people take greater control of their financial futures. Learn more at happymoney.com. View our Employee Privacy Policy here. 

Happy Money is a 100% fully distributed company. Remote work doesn’t mean less work, we work full-time jobs and show up to them fully every day. To learn more about our values and the way we work, review our Happy Money Way Overview!

 

ABOUT THE ROLE

Happy Money is hiring a Creative Marketing Manager to own creative and content across every channel we market in. The role is equal parts strategist and maker. You'll set creative direction, then do the hands-on writing, designing, shooting and editing to get it live. You'll be our lead designer across happymoney.com, paid social, paid search, lifecycle email, direct mail and organic social, and the on-camera face of Happy Money in short-form video for Instagram Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts. Your biggest focus will be telling our customers' stories: how people paid off debt and made progress toward their goals. You'll join as Happy Money rolls out a refreshed visual identity and help set how it shows up everywhere. You'll also own how that creative performs, from the first line of a page or the first second of a video to the click, and use the results to decide what to make next. You care about how a brand looks and feels, and when an ad works, you want to know why.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own creative strategy and execution across happymoney.com, paid social, paid search, lifecycle email, direct mail and organic social, with a documented content strategy, content calendar and roadmap tied to acquisition and brand goals
  • Own creative performance across the funnel, from hook to message to call to action: define success metrics and a testing plan before each launch, decide what to scale, cut or iterate on, and bring a new direction when a format plateaus
  • Design creative for every channel as Happy Money's primary in-house designer, including paid ads, direct mail pieces, email hero images and templates, landing pages and organic social
  • Set Happy Money's creative standard as our new visual identity rolls out, working within brand guidelines
  • Create content and creative for happymoney.com, including landing pages, articles, guides and product pages, and partner with SEO/AEO so it performs in search and AI answers
  • Lead Happy Money's organic social presence on Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and YouTube, and engage with followers in partnership with Customer Support
  • Appear on camera as the face of Happy Money's social channels, in content like a 30-second explainer video on APR versus interest rate
  • Plan, script, shoot and edit short-form video for Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts, and adapt paid creative so it feels native to organic and web
  • Tell customer impact stories through photo and video, interviews and user-generated content, and help share employee stories on our social channels
  • Build and manage a creator and influencer program, from finding and contracting partners to writing briefs and scripts and tracking results
  • Build and maintain a library of photos, video, graphics and licensed stock imagery, organized so the team can quickly find approved assets for campaigns
  • Evaluate and set up the tools, partners and AI-assisted workflows the creative function needs, including video editing and UGC platforms
  • Write clear briefs and run feedback loops with agencies, freelancers and creators
  • Coordinate with Communications on email, long-form copy and scripts so messaging stays consistent across channels
  • Bring compliance in early, move work through legal, compliance and bank partner review, and set up a faster path for time-sensitive organic posts
  • Balance creative priorities across acquisition, lifecycle, brand and product when requests compete
  • Track performance through dashboards and a weekly review covering impressions, engagement, site traffic and applications, and share results and what customers are saying with marketing leadership, product and lifecycle teams


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Creative improves acquisition efficiency and engagement, measured by CPA, CTR, conversion rate, engagement rate and applications
  • Day-to-day design for paid, email, direct mail, web and social is produced in-house
  • Happy Money’s web pages carry fresh, on-brand content and creative that supports conversion and search visibility
  • A steady testing cadence across channels, with learnings documented and winning concepts turned into repeatable formats
  • Organic social audiences and engagement grow quarter over quarter, with customer impact stories and on-camera explainers as a regular part of the mix
  • A creator and influencer program is running, with partners in place and results tracked against clear goals
  • The team works from an organized library of approved assets, and campaigns launch faster because of it

 

ABOUT YOU

  • 5+ years in graphic design, creative or content marketing, in-house or at an agency, with experience owning both strategy and execution
  • A portfolio with a mix of short-form and long-form work, including paid ads, email, direct mail or print, web content and video you shot, edited or appeared in, that tells a clear story visually
  • A strong graphic design foundation, through formal training or hands-on experience, including layout, typography, color and accessibility standards
  • Expert in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite, including Photoshop and Premiere Pro, plus a mobile editing tool like CapCut
  • Comfortable on camera and excited to be the face of Happy Money's social channels
  • Able to turn complex financial topics like APRs, credit scores and debt payoff into clear content
  • Experience building content strategies and calendars and creating content for websites, with a working understanding of SEO and conversion
  • Experience using performance data to guide creative decisions and changing course when the numbers call for it
  • Experience preparing print-ready files and working with print and mail vendors
  • A track record of growing organic social channels, with deep knowledge of social-first storytelling and platform trends on Instagram and TikTok
  • Highly organized and self-directed, comfortable running a test-and-learn channel without direction

 

BONUS POINTS FOR

  • Experience in lending, banking or another regulated industry; Fair Lending awareness
  • Copywriting and storytelling experience, including email, long-form web copy and video scripts
  • Experience building or managing creator or influencer partnerships
  • Email template development experience
  • Motion design skills
  • Familiarity with HubSpot, including HubSpot CMS

 

BENEFITS & PERKS

  • Generous medical, dental, and vision insurance options 
  • Eligible for Annual Bonus
  • 401k Plan with a matching contribution
  • Generous PTO including sick leave, vacation, volunteer, and more
  • 12 Weeks Paid Parental Leave
  • Company-paid short & long term disability and life insurance
  • Monthly tech stipend to help cover expenses for remote work
  • Happy Money is a 100% fully distributed workforce

Base Salary Range
$110,000—$130,000 USD

data.title: Senior Paid Search Specialist
data.location: Remote / Kansas City, MO / Chicago, IL / New York, NY / Denver, CO
data.content_html:
MissionOne Media is a brand within BarkleyOKRP that combines full-funnel media planning and buying services, CRM, data, analytics, retail media, SEO, and digital experiences. We’re an independent media partner offering transparency, integration, and a relentless focus on business impact. 

This is a full-time, remote position for a Senior Paid Search Specialist at BarkleyOKRP.  In this role, you will develop strategies and manage the performance of various paid search accounts, to drive client performance and growth. Exceptional communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a remote environment are essential. 

 

Qualities 

Here’s what it takes to be successful in the role: 

 

  • Curiosity and Skepticism:  You are always asking, “WHY?” You have an internal drive to learn more and expand your knowledge. You consider situations from multiple perspectives.   
  • Strategic, Creative Problem-Solving: You are analytical and enjoy working with data to derive insights. You use insights and knowledge to develop robust strategies and visions for success. You love coming up with creative solutions to new and old problems alike. 
  • Initiative: You are a gritty self-starter driven to find answers, solve tough problems, and overcome challenges. You proactively bring solutions to challenges. 
  • Communication & Storytelling: You can easily communicate complex information or nuanced situations. You know what details are necessary and what details to leave behind. You can marry data and storytelling to articulate a compelling vision. 
  • Adaptability: You can comfortably adjust in evolving or ambiguous situations. You use creativity to tackle new and existing challenges. You’re ready and excited for changes in the media landscape.  
  • Self-Development: You’re reflective and self-aware. You seek opportunities to learn and develop yourself and others.  

Skills  

  • Google Ads & Bing Ads mastery 
  • Mastery in Excel/Google Sheets, PowerPoint/Google Slides, Microsoft Word/Google Docs 
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills 
  • Proficient with SEM reporting and third party analytics tools (E.g. GA4, Adobe, etc.) 
  • Certification in Google AdWords (or ability to obtain certification). 
  • Experience managing data feeds and shopping campaigns. 

 

Responsibilities: 

  • Paid Search Management in Google & Bing Platforms as well as through our proprietary tool: Deep Search. 
  • Target & Budget Management: The Sr. Paid Search Specialist independently manages budgets and campaign targets to achieve or exceed client goals, with the ability to pivot and/or make proactive recommendations as client goals shift. Proactively creates target management solutions and tracking to improve performance. Ensures spend and revenue stay in line with goal and proactively communicates with client and team when performance challenges arise. 
  • Campaign Structure: Stewardship over campaign structure, with ability to evangelize best practices and fluency in testing out new structures. Ensures campaigns are set up properly to appropriately spend and perform, including targeting, ads, and scheduling. Ensures ad copy, extensions, and GMC promos are aligned with appropriate promotions. Conduct thorough keyword research to identify high-performing keywords and negative keywords to optimize campaign performance. Proactively recommends how to enhance campaign performance/account structure. 
  • Reporting & Analysis: Independently owns regular and ad hoc client-facing reporting in Deep Search, Google Ads, Microsoft, and other tools as required by client. Strong ability to recognize and communicate performance trends and to connect the dots between performance trends and campaign management. Proactively digs in to performance to inform campaign changes and roots of changes to performance trends. Leads diagnosing account issues and steps needed to improve performance. Able to dig into niche performance questions, pulling together data from multiple sources and telling a coherent performance story for the client. 
  • Strategy & Innovation: Leads strategic planning for entire account(s) and has full command of account’s Paid Search strategy. Proactively works with Supervisor and Director on testing roadmaps and plans. Owns the why behind account and campaign set up. Proactively explores and investigates additional strategies that will help enhance client's performance. Leads testing planning, execution, and reporting. 
  • Communication & Storytelling: Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, serving as the primary point of contact for all paid search-related inquiries and updates. Proactively update clients on performance and industry trends. Leads client calls and owns the day-to-day relationship with professionalism and enthusiasm. Ensure consistent and thorough follow-ups from client requests and post client meetings. Ensures client emails are answered in a timely manner. 

 

Qualifications:  

  • 2+ years or more years in a fast-paced agency, media, or marketing environment, hands-on experience building and managing paid search campaigns. 

 

Compensation  

The annual gross base salary range is $60,000- $85,000 USD. This range represents the anticipated target salary range for this position. Actual salaries will vary and are based on factors such as a candidate’s qualifications, skills, and geographic location. Salary is one component of BarkleyOKRP's total compensation package, which includes multiple health insurance options, flexible PTO, life insurance, and 401K.

data.location: Germany (Remote) ; Ireland (Remote); Netherlands (Remote) ; Portugal (Remote) ; Spain (Remote) ; United Kingdom (Remote)
data.content_html:
Who we are

Typeform is a refreshingly different form builder. We help over 150,000 businesses collect the data they need with forms, surveys, and quizzes that people enjoy. Designed to look striking and feel effortless to fill out, Typeform drives 500 million responses every year—and integrates with essential tools like Slack, Zapier, and Hubspot.

Typeform is fully remote by design. For this role, we can hire candidates based in the UK, Ireland, Germany, Portugal, Spain or The Netherlands

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Paid Marketing Strategist to help us rethink how Typeform approaches paid acquisition.

You’ll own and grow key channels including TikTok, YouTube, Google Performance Max and Uber Ads, while helping us test new opportunities across areas such as audio and CTV.

This is a hands on role with real ownership. You’ll manage significant media budgets, build channel strategy, develop campaigns, work closely with our creative teams, and help us understand the true business impact of our investment through MMM, incrementality testing and other measurement approaches.

You’ll join the Acquisition team within Marketing and partner closely with Creative, Product Marketing, Data, RevOps and Finance.

What you’ll do

  • Own the strategy and day to day performance of key paid social and display channels, including TikTok, YouTube, Google Performance Max and Uber Ads.
  • Build a multichannel strategy that helps Typeform reduce its reliance on paid search and find new sources of efficient growth.
  • Manage six figure monthly media budgets, making decisions based on customer acquisition, revenue, CAC and LTV to CAC performance.
  • Build, launch and optimise campaigns that drive Typeform signups and new paid customers.
  • Turn creative ideas into campaigns by briefing and partnering closely with copywriters and designers.
  • Run A/B tests across creative, copy, landing pages, placements, audiences and bidding strategies.
  • Explore and test new channels such as audio and CTV.
  • Own and develop our paid marketing measurement approach, including Marketing Mix Modelling, incrementality studies and alternative measurement frameworks.
  • Design experiments that help us understand the incremental impact of our campaigns rather than relying solely on traditional attribution.
  • Work closely with our Tracking and Data teams to strengthen our measurement capabilities as digital advertising continues to change.
  • Share insights, results and recommendations across Marketing and the wider business.
  • Contribute to Typeform’s broader full funnel acquisition strategy across demand creation and demand capture.

What we’re looking for

  • Around six or more years of hands on and strategic experience in performance marketing and media buying.
  • Strong experience managing paid social and video channels, ideally including TikTok, YouTube and Meta.
  • Experience owning campaigns from initial idea and creative brief through implementation, optimisation and measurement.
  • A track record of managing six figure budgets and delivering efficient performance.
  • Experience working with MMM, incrementality testing or other measurement methods beyond traditional attribution.
  • Strong analytical skills and confidence working with campaign performance, conversion funnels, CAC and LTV.
  • A strong understanding of digital measurement, from tagging and attribution through to incrementality.
  • Experience developing creative and UGC assets for paid social channels.
  • The ability to balance creative thinking with strong commercial judgement.
  • Curiosity and a willingness to figure things out. When you do not know the answer, you know how to find it, whether that means speaking to the right person, digging into documentation or using AI tools.
  • Confidence working across teams and influencing partners in Creative, Product Marketing, Data and Finance.
  • Comfort operating with uncertainty. You are happy testing ideas, learning from the results and changing direction when the data tells you to.

Nice to have

  • Experience working in SaaS or B2B lead generation.
  • Experience across sales technology or marketing technology.
  • Experience managing external agencies or digital production partners.
  • Experience with ad servers and campaign trafficking.

*Typeform drives hundreds of millions of interactions each year, enabling conversational, human-centered experiences across the globe. We move as one team, empowering our collective efforts by valuing each individual’s unique perspective. This fosters strong bonds grounded in respect, transparency, and trust. We champion our diverse customer base by anticipating their needs and addressing their challenges with priority. Committed to excellence, we hold high expectations for ourselves and each other, continuously striving to deliver exceptional results.

We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and stand firmly against discrimination and harassment of any kind—whether based on race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. Everyone is welcome here.
